# Constructed Gaussian reserves and compatible center responses

27 October 2026. A representation theorem for finite affine value-query
programs, not an assumption about arbitrary current laws or rejection samplers.

Let external x be in R^d and let Z have s standard Gaussian d-vector slots.
A fixed program makes physical queries

    q_i=u_i+b_i x+sum_{j<i}a_ij g(q_j)+sum_k B_ik Z_k,

and returns a p-slot output

    Y=c x+v+sum_j f_j g(q_j)+D Z.

All displayed coefficients are known and independent of x,Z and source
values. Known scalar Gaussian transformations and affine composition preserve
this class; source-dependent branches and nonlinear coefficients need not.
All program and coefficient-acquisition costs remain charged.

Write B^dagger for the Moore--Penrose inverse and P=B^dagger B. Suppose
b is in range B. Define

    U=b x+B Z,    a=c-D B^dagger b,    R=D(I-P)D^T.

Induction over the queries shows that every q_i and returned source value is a
function of U. Orthogonal Gaussian decomposition therefore gives the EXACT
representation

    Y=a x+Psi(U)+D(I-P)Z,
    Psi(U)=v+D B^dagger U+sum_j f_j g(q_j(U)).           (1)

The last term is N(0,R tensor I_d), independent of U. Its covariance is
constructed from code by finite known linear algebra. It is the largest
reserve obtained by removing a linear seed subspace preserving every
physical query. Source-specific additional cancellations are not excluded.

The minimum-norm query-preserving center gauge is v0=-B^dagger b. For all
x,Z,Delta, the change (x,Z)->(x+Delta,Z+v0 tensor Delta) leaves all queries
unchanged and changes Y by the KNOWN affine response a Delta. Thus

    Y0(x,Z)=Y(x,Z)-a x

has a zero-output center gauge v0 and the same exact reserve. If R>0, set

    W=(I-P)D^T R^{-1}.

Then BW=0, DW=I, W^T W=R^{-1}, and v0^T W=0. Shifting seeds by W tensor h
leaves every source query unchanged and shifts the output by h. Both the
reserve and the compatible response have been constructed, with no source
mean, derivative, fitted field, or conditional-distribution operation.

For the original, unmodified output, a zero-output center gauge orthogonal
to this reserve exists exactly when a=0. If a is nonzero, the general gauge
v0-Wa spends a reserve component. Requiring orthogonality without checking
this condition would be a false closure claim.

AUDIT OF CLOUD-ONLY ACQUISITION LOWER BOUND AND NORMAL FORM
27 October 2026

Audited research/round2_main/CLOUD_ONLY_ACQUISITION_LOWER_BOUND.md,
check_cloud_only_bound.py, and AFFINE_ORACLE_NORMAL_FORM.md.

VERDICT: The positive-kappa lower bound and its exact integer witnesses are
valid under the stated intermediate-oracle contract. It is not an N687
original-value-query lower bound.

Gaussian sufficiency: pre-generate n independent observations and simulate
any bounded adaptive stopping policy by revealing only its requested prefix.
The full sample mean has law N(theta,tau^2/n); the Gaussian residual vector
is independent of the mean and theta. Unrestricted fixed-g evaluations and
auxiliary randomness can therefore be absorbed into a positive Markov
kernel acting on the mean. No adaptivity information is lost.

Fourier constants: bounded complex characteristic tests differ by at most
2 TV. Long-interval coefficients handle nonperiodic kernels. At u=1/S,
z=kappa exp(-1/2)<=1 and J1(z)>=z/2-z^3/16>=7z/16. The target coefficient
is >=7kappa/(16e)>7kappa/48. Subtracting 2epsilon<=kappa/16 leaves a
strict lower bound kappa/12 on exp[-tau^2/(2nr^2)]. Taking logarithms
gives n>=tau^2/[2r^2 log(12/kappa)]. The claim should specify 0<kappa<=1.
With zero center observations the Fourier coefficient is zero, so the same
target coefficient immediately makes the requested uniform error impossible.

Fisher comparison wording: this particular cosine source has
max_theta |m'(theta)|=L exp(-1/2). Thus its EXACT local Fisher necessity is
n>=tau^2 L^2/(e S^2), while tau^2 L^2/S^2 is the conservative generic
Lipschitz scale. Either wording preserves the asserted asymptotic gap, but
the latter should not be called the exact Fisher requirement of the cosine
family. For L=S=tau=1 and r=kappa the exact Fisher scale is 1/e rather
than one; integer feasibility then requires at least one observation.

Exact code: independently reran check_cloud_only_bound.py. All five
rational attenuation comparisons passed. The floating logarithm merely
proposes n0. Whether or not it rounds the mathematical floor correctly,
the exact inequality exp[-1/(2 n0 kappa^2)]<kappa/12 certifies that n0
observations are impossible; monotonicity gives the same for every smaller
positive count. There is no finite-moment inference or source calibration.

1. Full-joint record absorption. With LL^T=C,TT^T=C_new and
D=[-T^-1 L;H A L],the proposed precision condition gives
D^T D=L^T(C_new^-1+A^T H^T H A)L=I-L^T J L.
Thus P P^T=I-DD^T is a known valid Gaussian covariance. The exact child gauge
turns its noisy center into effective seeds PG-DZ;their complete covariance is
I. They are jointly Gaussian,so all effective slots,retained record and
standalone children have the claimed independence. This is more than covariance
matching of non-Gaussian outputs. TV contracts under the actual Markov kernel,
then independent standalone errors add. All metadata must be fixed independently
of the observed noisy record;data-dependent coefficients invalidate the proof.

Final DAG precision is D_noise^-1-A^T Gamma A. Its positive definiteness implies
the intermediate condition by principal restriction plus unread PSD costs.
The W2 coordinate recurrence pays each downstream center Lipschitz coefficient;
it does not assume independent actual errors. Query caps survive correlated
seeds only because they hold on EVERY execution. Final affine variance must
remain below the target before any fresh reserve is added.

For response closure r=C P1 u and q=[T^-1(u-r);H A r] satisfy D^Tq=0.
The direct energy is u^T(P1-P1 C P1)u;combined with the existing response bound
it yields rho^-1 P1. Child reserve orthogonality kills cross terms. The external
gauge construction has fresh energy s-t and old-response energy<=t/rho,
so its increment is<=sqrt(s/rho). It cannot be declared orthogonal to every
constructed reserve. The unused-slot augmentation preserves actual output and
queries while paying factor2 reserve loss and sqrt(2) gauge growth per promotion.
Neither isolated factor establishes total polylog closure.
